title: Longer than a mayfly's whole grown-up life
detail: Most adult mayflies live less than a day. You made it through a full one.

title: Longer than Lindbergh's flight across the Atlantic
detail: Charles Lindbergh flew nonstop from New York to Paris in 1927 in about 33½ hours.

title: Longer than the whole Apollo 11 mission
detail: In July 1969 the crew flew to the Moon, walked on it and came home in 8 days and 3 hours.

title: As long as it takes a chick to hatch
detail: A chicken egg takes 21 days to hatch.

title: The Moon has gone all the way around the Earth
detail: One trip around takes the Moon about 27⅓ days.

title: A full cycle of the Moon's phases
detail: New moon to new moon takes about 29½ days.

title: More than 1,000 hours
detail: Six weeks is 1,008 hours, each one lived one at a time.

title: Longer than one day on Mercury
detail: Mercury spins so slowly that one turn takes about 59 Earth days.

title: As long as sea turtle eggs take to hatch
detail: Sea turtle eggs stay buried in warm sand for about two months before the hatchlings dig out.

title: As long as an emperor penguin dad keeps watch
detail: Emperor penguin fathers hold their egg on their feet through the Antarctic winter for about 65 days, without eating.

title: A whole year on Mercury
detail: Mercury goes around the Sun every 88 days.

title: As long as Sputnik 1 stayed in orbit
detail: The first satellite circled the Earth for 92 days, from October 1957 to January 1958.

title: Triple digits
detail: 100 days in a row.

title: As long as the Perseverance rover's trip to Mars
detail: NASA's rover launched on July 30, 2020 and landed on Mars 203 days later.

title: A whole year on Venus
detail: Venus goes around the Sun every 225 Earth days.

title: One day on Venus
detail: Venus takes 243 Earth days to spin once, so its day is longer than its year.

title: Longer than a blue whale's pregnancy
detail: A blue whale calf grows for about 11 months before it's born, already the size of a bus.

title: As long as it took to build the Empire State Building
detail: Work began on March 17, 1930, and it opened 410 days later, on May 1, 1931.

title: More than 10,000 hours
detail: The number of hours often said to make someone an expert. You're getting good at this.

title: Longer than anyone has stayed in space in one trip
detail: Cosmonaut Valeri Polyakov spent about 437 days aboard the Mir space station in 1994 and 1995, the longest single spaceflight on record.

title: 500 days
detail: Halfway to a thousand.

title: Longer than an elephant's pregnancy
detail: African elephants carry their calves for about 22 months, the longest of any land animal.

title: A whole year on Mars
detail: Mars takes 687 Earth days to go around the Sun.

title: A million minutes
detail: One million minutes, give or take a few.

title: 100 weeks
detail: One hundred weeks in a row.

title: As long as it took to build the Eiffel Tower
detail: Work ran from January 28, 1887 to March 31, 1889: 2 years, 2 months and 5 days.

title: As long as the Lewis and Clark expedition
detail: They set out in May 1804 and came back to St. Louis in September 1806, 862 days later.

title: 1,000 days
detail: Four digits.

title: As long as the first voyage around the world
detail: Magellan's fleet left Spain in September 1519. One ship, led by Juan Sebastián Elcano, made it home in September 1522.

title: 1,111 days
detail: All ones. Make a wish.

title: As long as Darwin's voyage on the Beagle
detail: The Beagle sailed from England in December 1831 and came home in October 1836.

title: 2,000 days
detail: Two thousand days, one at a time.

title: 2,222 days
detail: All twos.

title: 3,000 days
detail: Three thousand days, one at a time.

title: 3,333 days
detail: All threes.

title: 100,000 hours
detail: A hundred thousand hours.

title: A whole year on Jupiter
detail: Jupiter takes about 4,333 Earth days, nearly 12 years, to go around the Sun.

title: 4,444 days
detail: All fours.

title: As long as 13-year cicadas wait underground
detail: Some periodical cicadas spend 13 years underground before coming up into the sun, all at once.

title: 5,000 days
detail: Five thousand days, one at a time.

title: 5,555 days
detail: All fives.

title: As long as 17-year cicadas wait underground
detail: The longest-lived periodical cicadas spend 17 years underground before coming up into the sun.

title: Ten million minutes
detail: Ten million minutes, one at a time.

title: 1,000 weeks
detail: A thousand weeks in a row.

title: 7,777 days
detail: All sevens. Lucky.

title: 8,888 days
detail: All eights.

title: 9,999 days
detail: Five digits tomorrow.

title: 10,000 days
detail: More than 27 years.

title: A whole year on Saturn
detail: Saturn takes about 10,759 Earth days, nearly 29½ years, to go around the Sun.

title: A billion seconds
detail: One billion seconds is about 31 years and 8 months.
